validation_note: 372 regression tests passed. Saved benchmark, compressed-map, preserved original artifacts and baseline-code hashes were verified. Browser checks passed for the corrected map: national and exact outlines, main-island extent, inspection of connection hi-water-005 and its endpoints, and navigation to the comparison. The comparison was readable and matched the saved report. Static type checking could not run because mypy is not installed in the project environment.
measurement_notes: Both are complete pipelines in fresh processes on a shared desktop, with warm source and physical graph caches.
Runs occurred at different times; these are observations, not isolated head-to-head hardware measurements.
Full pipeline includes preparation, policy construction, solving, repair, audits and export.
Only the new run uses corrected numerical code; code hashes are deliberately different and recorded.
The prior fixed-center diagnostic was not a connected plan or full benchmark and is not used as the runtime baseline.
Physical shared-edge connectivity and connectivity through recorded water links remain separate metrics.
